findings.title: The newly introduced initially-open mobile Drawer does not establish a focus trap
findings.evidence: On mobile, the already-open onboarding surface switches from Dialog to a newly mounted Drawer. packages/ui/src/components/drawer.tsx:33-38 invokes useDismissableLayer(open, ...) while mounted is still false and returns null. The hook effect therefore captures a null container, and unlike Dialog's mounted && open fix at dialog.tsx:29-35, it does not rerun when the portal mounts. Initial focus remains outside; use-dismissable-layer.ts:53-59 also does not intercept forward Tab when activeIndex is -1, so keyboard focus can enter background controls. The new onboarding test only checks role/content/close, not focus containment.
findings.expected_fix: Ensure an initially-open mobile onboarding Drawer moves focus inside, traps Tab, and restores focus correctly.

implementation_guidance.approach: Make Drawer gate useDismissableLayer on mounted && open as Dialog does, or otherwise rerun focus initialization after the portal ref exists; verify both initially-open and false-to-true Drawer lifecycles.
tests: Mount EditorView directly in mobile mode with onboarding open and assert focus moves to the first drawer control.
Press forward and reverse Tab repeatedly and assert focus never reaches editor controls behind the drawer.
Close with Escape and the close button and assert focus restoration is sensible.
Retain tests for drawers opened after mount.
done_when: Initially-open and subsequently-open Drawers both establish focus after their portal mounts.
Forward and reverse Tab cannot leave the modal surface.
Escape/close restores focus without exposing background interaction.

findings.title: Video link editor becomes stale after undo or redo
findings.evidence: VideoLinkField initializes draft from value once with useState(value), but the parent key is only element.id. After a valid link edit is committed, undo/redo changes element.content without changing the ID, so the mounted input keeps the old local draft rather than reflecting document history. A later blur can recommit that stale value and overwrite the undone state. Current tests deselect/reselect after validation but never exercise undo/redo while the field remains mounted.
findings.expected_fix: Keep the video field synchronized with authoritative document history without discarding active user input.

implementation_guidance.approach: Synchronize local draft/error state when the authoritative value changes outside the current edit transaction, or key/remount the field by an appropriate revision/value while preserving deliberate in-progress edits.
tests: Commit a valid edit, click Undo, and assert both canvas content and input show the original URL.
Click Redo and assert both show the edited URL.
After undo, blur the field without changing it and assert the undone value is not overwritten.
Repeat after an invalid local draft and after switching selected elements.
done_when: The input always reflects the current document value after undo, redo, restore, and external replacement.
No stale blur/Enter commit can reverse a history transition.
Invalid edits still never reach CardEditorState or draft storage.

findings.title: No-op page and layer actions still create undo entries
findings.evidence: commit always appends and increments historyIndex even when an updater returns the unchanged state. deletePage on the last page, edge movePage calls, missing-ID duplicate/delete/reorder, and already-front/back layer actions therefore enable Undo without changing the document. The earlier baseline noted this behavior, and no no-op history-boundary test was added.
findings.expected_fix: Do not append history when an action produces no document mutation.

summary: Full review completed for all 119 implementation paths and every prior finding from cycles 004-007. Five major defects remain: fidelity statuses do not prove parity, current-cycle evidence has conflicting test totals, export parity remains incomplete, the new initially-open mobile onboarding Drawer lacks a valid focus lifecycle, and VideoLinkField becomes stale across undo/redo. One baseline minor no-op history issue also remains. The implementation is not technically ready for user acceptance.
